_comment: The creatures of the integrated addon. A creature is a data entry: add one here, point `build` at its
model build, and run build-kj-dedushka.ps1. Nothing in the kj script set names a creature.
key          short name: its clips live under uddedushka/anim_<key>, -Creatures picks by it
class        the CfgVehicles class a mission makes
model        file stem of its P3D in the pbo (also its CfgModels class)
moves        its own moves class (generated from the shared moves_dedushka.hpp)
build        a finished model build: dedushka.p3d, dedushka_rest.json (the joint file),
sounds       its own voice: shared sound class -> the class this creature uses instead. A class the mounted
sound set does not have falls back to the shared one (KJ_Hurt, the cry at a hard hit, to silence)
voicePbo     optional: a pbo with more sound classes for it, copied into the mount when the file exists
